conventions.priority: lower = first. Agent picks highest-priority story where passes: false.
conventions.passes: set true ONLY when ALL acceptanceCriteria are met AND make verify-local is green.
conventions.acceptanceCriteria: behavioral outcomes (WHAT to verify), not implementation (HOW). Each must include a connection criterion where applicable.
conventions.stop: emit <promise>COMPLETE</promise> only when ALL stories pass. Otherwise end normally (loop continues).

userStories.title: Wire calculate_max_units to consume DistrictDimensionalStandard
acceptanceCriteria: calculate_max_units accepts a DistrictDimensionalStandard (or a caller converts via .to_numeric_zoning_params()) when one is available for the parcel's district
When given a DistrictDimensionalStandard, the resulting DensityAnalysis is labeled as derived from a verified-fact source (origin=local_authority), not LLM-extracted
The existing LLM-extracted NumericZoningParams path still works as fallback when no typed standard is available
Contract test: given a DistrictDimensionalStandard for RS-8, calculate_max_units returns the same max_units as the equivalent NumericZoningParams
make verify-local green
userStories.notes: Slice 1.1 built the extractor + type but it's an island. This wires the consumer. lookup.py:_agentic_analysis is the call site that should prefer the typed standard when available.

userStories.title: Wire _agentic_analysis to emit typed Claims
acceptanceCriteria: _agentic_analysis (pipeline/lookup.py) produces Claim objects for the zoning facts it extracts (zoning.district, standards.setback_front_ft, etc.) in addition to the ZoningReport
A zoning.district Claim has kind=verified_fact, origin=local_authority when sourced from indexed ordinance text; kind=assumption, origin=unknown when from LLM fallback
A cost.* or financing.* Claim is never kind=verified_fact (boundary invariant holds at the emission point)
Claims are returned alongside the ZoningReport (e.g. report.claims or a parallel return) so downstream consumers can use them
Contract test: _agentic_analysis on a mocked ordinance input emits at least one zoning.district Claim with origin=local_authority
make verify-local green
userStories.notes: Slice 2.1 built the Claim type but it's an island. This wires the primary producer. No ClaimLog storage yet (Phase 6) — just emit the Claims in-memory for now.

userStories.title: Generalize dimensional extractor to 3 municipalities
acceptanceCriteria: extract_dimensional_standards runs on Fort Lauderdale + 2 more FL municipalities (e.g. Miami, Hollywood) and returns typed rows for each
Each row has source_section_id provenance pointing at the originating ordinance section
Live verification (PLOTLOT_LIVE_TESTS=1): integration test asserts ≥1 municipality returns rows with all numeric fields populated for ≥3 districts
make verify-local green
userStories.notes: Slice 1.1 proved FL works; this generalizes. Reconcile field names against live schema per Slice 1.2 lesson.

userStories.title: calculate_max_units reads from DistrictDimensionalStandard (production path)
acceptanceCriteria: When a DistrictDimensionalStandard exists for the parcel's district, lookup.py uses it instead of LLM-extracted NumericZoningParams
The resulting standards.max_units Claim is kind=calculation, origin=local_authority (inherited from the source standard)
When no standard exists, falls back to LLM extraction with kind=calculation, origin=unknown (labeled assumption-grade)
Contract test: with a standard present, no LLM call is made for zoning params; without, the LLM path runs
make verify-local green
userStories.notes: Depends on WIRE-1.1b + 3.2. This is the verified-fact path replacing LLM extraction at query time.

userStories.title: Freshness as typed claim
acceptanceCriteria: A chunk whose amended_date > scraped_at produces a freshness=stale flag on the derived Claim
A stale zoning.* Claim cannot satisfy a verified_fact prerequisite (the planner/guardrail blocks it)
Contract test: a stale chunk yields freshness=stale; a fresh chunk yields freshness=fresh
make verify-local green
userStories.notes: Kleyman: 'refresh before relying'. Enforced at the claim layer.

userStories.title: Backfill Fort Lauderdale evidence graph end-to-end
acceptanceCriteria: For Fort Lauderdale: every residential district has a DistrictDimensionalStandard, every ingested section has path + cross_refs populated, freshness is computed
Live verification: a query for RS-8 setbacks returns the typed standard (not an LLM extraction)
Integration test (PLOTLOT_LIVE_TESTS=1) pins the FL evidence graph is complete
make verify-local green
userStories.notes: FL is the reference municipality for developing the agent loop against.

userStories.title: Ingestion eval — golden queries post-ingest
acceptanceCriteria: After ingest, a golden set of queries ('what is the RS-8 setback?') returns the typed row; hit-rate >= 90%
Eval runs in tests/eval/ and is wired to make eval (or a documented command)
A botched ingest (low hit-rate) is detectable by the eval, not shipped silently
make verify-local green
userStories.notes: This is the verification gate inside the autonomous-ingestion skill (Phase 9).
